verdict.rationale: Recurring scheduling is a fair question for a serverless compute platform like Modal, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack contains no mention of cron, schedules, or periodic execution. The closest item (modal-docs-15) describes spawning one-off async background work, which is a one-off action, not a recurring schedule, so it earns no credit.
